# Thruster flame: a 6-sided cone 0.8 m long pointing down, a cream core in a tan sheath, origin
# at its top (the nozzle's mouth); the game stretches and flickers it. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sheath --base-color 0.765 0.639 0.541 --no-slot --emission 0.765 0.639 0.541
material new Core --base-color 0.965 0.839 0.741 --no-slot --emission 0.965 0.839 0.741
add mesh cone --name Sheath --vertices 6 --radius1 0.05 --radius2 0.24 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 -0.4
material assign Sheath
add mesh cone --name Core --vertices 6 --radius1 0.04 --radius2 0.15 --depth 0.5 --location 0 -0.1 -0.25
material assign Core
select all
shade flat
export flame.glb
